<function name="GetVisibleAreas" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>
		Returns all <page>CNavArea</page>s that are visible from this <page>CNavArea</page>.
	</description>
	<added>2023.06.28</added>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="areas" type="table">
			A sequential table containing all <page>CNavArea</page>s that are visible from this <page>CNavArea</page>.					
		</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
